Support

Questions, a bug or an idea? Email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}. Your iPhone model, iOS version and the app version (Settings > About) help a lot. In the app, Settings > About > Contact support adds the version for you.

Apple Health shows no data

Open the Health app, tap your picture, then Privacy > Apps > All Dae., and turn on the categories you want to share.

iCloud sync isn't working

Check you are signed in to iCloud on every device, then turn on sync in All Dae. under Settings > Your data. The first sync can take a few minutes.

Moving to a new iPhone

Turn on iCloud sync, or use Settings > Your data > Create complete JSON backup, then Restore from JSON backup on the new iPhone.

Deleting your data

Settings > Your data > Delete all data removes everything All Dae. stores on your iPhone. There is no account to close.

All Dae. is a general wellness app and does not provide medical advice.
